title: SupplierReturnChanged
description: Published by the supplier-return processor once per return, when it is submitted, with the return as stored and every line that is not deleted. Drafts and cancelled drafts are never published. Every field is present; an unknown value is null. Attributes: Tenant-Id, Business-Unit-Id, Supplier-Return-Id, Status, Correlation-Id (the submit api event's) and Event-Id = <supplierReturnId>-SUBMITTED, identical on every publish of the return. Ordering key: <tenantId>-<supplierReturnId>.

supplierReturnId.description: Id of the supplier return, generated by the client

returnNumber.description: Readable number assigned at submit: SR- and a per-tenant sequence zero-padded to six digits, for example SR-000231

returnToType.description: What returnToId identifies: a business partner, or a warehouse business unit in Business Unit Management. Goods Received's shipper-type values

returnToId.description: Id of the business partner or warehouse business unit the goods are returned to

returnToName.description: Name of the destination, snapshotted at submit

returnToAddress.title: SupplierReturnAddress
returnToAddress.description: The destination's first Delivery address, else its first Postal address, snapshotted at submit. Null when the destination has neither. A warehouse address takes countryCode from its business unit and has email null

addressType.description: Which of the destination's addresses this is

contactPerson.description: Name of the contact person at this address

status.description: Status of the return. Only SUBMITTED is published in v1; later statuses may be added

supplierReference.description: The receiver's own reference for the return (RMA). Set whenever a line's reason code requires a reference number

packageCount.description: How many packages the goods travel in

createdBy.description: Id of the user who created the draft

submittedBy.description: Id of the user who submitted the return

submittedDatetime.description: When the api accepted the submit

createdDatetime.description: When the processor stored the draft

modifiedDatetime.description: When the processor last wrote the return

lines.description: Every line of the return that is not deleted

SupplierReturnLine.title: SupplierReturnLine
SupplierReturnLine.description: A returned item with its total quantity and, for a return to a business partner, the price allocations of that quantity

lineId.description: Id of the line, generated by the client

gtin.description: GTIN the item was scanned with

itemName.description: Name of the item, as shown to staff

salesUnitOfMeasurement.description: The item's sales unit of measurement, snapshotted when the line was written, for example EA or KGM

quantity.description: Total quantity returned on this line, in the sales unit of measurement, exactly as entered

reasonCodeId.description: Id of the reason code in the SupplierReturn group

reasonCodeName.description: Name of the reason code, snapshotted when the line was written

supplierVerification.description: Whether the destination is known to supply the item: DELIVERED (it delivered the item in the last 12 months), ORDERING_OPTION (it is the source of a valid ordering option), OVERRIDE (another partner or warehouse delivered it and staff overrode), NOT_VERIFIED (nobody delivered it)

allocations.description: The line's quantity split across price sources, in allocationNumber order. Their quantities sum to the line's quantity. Empty for a return to a warehouse

SupplierReturnLineAllocation.title: SupplierReturnLineAllocation
SupplierReturnLineAllocation.description: A part of a line's quantity and the unit price it is credited at. At most one allocation of a line is not GOODS_RECEIVED

allocationNumber.description: Position of the allocation on the line: 1, 2, ... in the order staff entered them

priceSource.description: Where unitPrice comes from: a received delivery line, the ordering option's purchase price, the store's stock cost price, or a price staff entered

quantity.description: Quantity credited at this price, in the line's sales unit of measurement

unitPrice.description: Price per sales unit of measurement, resolved when the line was written

goodsReceivedId.description: Id of the Goods Received delivery. Set only for GOODS_RECEIVED

goodsReceivedLineId.description: Id of the line on the Goods Received delivery, as text. Set only for GOODS_RECEIVED
